test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. Z sits second to the right of T. S sits second to the right of V. R sits to the immediate left of T. Only three people sit between K and R. S sits third to the left of K.

If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of people seated?
solution:
Given: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. 

1) Z sits second to the right of T. 

2) R sits to the immediate left of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e9ea635257ef729b8cdca883448c50ffbf6c0a1468b61b838c44199631fbe51.png] 

3) Only three people sit between K and R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a84d6985cab31caa804ddc6ab9009553835ade132e273ecc1e5cef9bbfa14eb.png] 

4) S sits third to the left of K. 

5) S sits second to the right of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ec4bf197025597170aeb0a5479542fa7052136eda0cdc6555ff77e7dff1149b.png] 

If no other person is sitting in the row, then '13' people seated in that row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
